first_name.description: must be a string and is required

last_name.description: must be a string and is required

username.description: must be a string and is required

email.description: must be a valid email string and is required

password.description: must be a string and is required

profile_picture_url.description: optional string URL for profile picture

created_at.description: timestamp recording when the user registered

updated_at.description: timestamp recording when the user profile was last updated

user.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the user who created the trip

destination.description: must be a string and is required

startDate.description: must be a date and is required

endDate.description: must be a date and is required

budget.description: must be a number if specified

user.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the user who created the post

trip.description: optional ObjectId referencing the trip associated with this post

caption.description: must be a string containing post text/description

media_urls.description: must be an array of image/video URL strings

likes.description: must be an array of user ObjectIds who liked this post

created_at.description: must be a date recording when the post was published

sender.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the message sender

receiver.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the recipient user or trip group

text.description: must be a string containing the message content

sent_at.description: must be a date recording when the message was sent

is_read.description: must be a boolean indicating if the recipient read the message

user.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the User who saved the trip

trip.description: must be an ObjectId referencing the saved Trip

savedAt.description: must be a date recording when it was saved
